newsitem.title: USA: North Central Bancshares to buy back stock.
newsitem.headline: North Central Bancshares to buy back stock.

text.p: North Central Bancshares Inc said Monday it applied for regulatory approval from the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision for an initial stock repurchase program.
Under that program, North Central plans to buy back up to five percent of its 4,011,057 outstanding common shares.
The shares would be repurchased during the next six-month period beginning on the third business day following announcement of the company's earnings or, if later, Office of Thrift approval.
The repurchases will be made from time to time, in open market transactions, at the discretion of management.
North Central Bancshares is the parent of First Federal Savings Bank of Fort Dodge.
